recipe.visualDefinition: A classic mid-century album cover featuring a high-glamour studio portrait of a blonde woman in a voluminous emerald and teal satin gown, set against a neutral studio backdrop. The composition is split, with the portrait occupying the left two-thirds and a solid black vertical panel on the right containing vibrant pink script and white sans-serif text. A blue horizontal header bar runs across the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the warm skin tones and the cool emerald/teal fabric
Juxtaposition of the organic portrait against the rigid black geometric sidebar
Vibrant pink script popping against the deep black background
Horizontal blue header balancing the vertical black sidebar

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Portrait is positioned off-center to the left, scaled to fill the height of the frame from chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and red lips serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the portrait, move right to the pink script, then down the tracklist, and finally up to the blue header.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The black sidebar acts as functional negative space for typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the garment and accents against a muted, neutral studio background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed upright script and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Script features high-contrast strokes with looped ascenders and descenders
Sans-serif is ultra-condensed with uniform stroke weight
Header text is bold, blocky, and slightly shadowed
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'M' and 'J' have exaggerated, elegant loops
Horizontal bars in the script are elongated for decorative effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, feminine script paired with rigid, masculine condensed sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century brush script feel
Matches the ultra-condensed sans-serif list style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-glamour 1950s studio portrait of a blonde woman with a soft wave hairstyle, wearing a voluminous emerald green and teal satin gown with a high architectural collar. The background is a neutral grey-to-white gradient. Include a solid sky-blue bar at the very top and a solid black vertical panel covering the right third of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, stacked hot-pink script lettering in the top half of the black panel. Below it, add a list of song titles in small, white, ultra-condensed uppercase sans-serif. In the blue top bar, add bold, dark blue sans-serif text with a slight drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait lighting soft and glamorous?
Is the black sidebar perfectly vertical and opaque?
Does the pink script have a hand-drawn, fluid quality?
Is the blue header bar a flat, solid color?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script text does not overlap the portrait
Check that the blue header is exactly at the top edge
Verify the satin texture looks realistic and not plastic
Confirm the sans-serif text is legible and properly spaced
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait(Left 2/3) + Black Sidebar(Right 1/3) + Blue Header(Top) + Script/Sans-serif Pairing
